details: Assouad proved $\mathrm{VC}^{*}(\mathcal H)\leq2^{\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)+1}-1$. Thus, when the dual VC dimension is positive, $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)\geq\tfrac12\log_2\mathrm{VC}^{*}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: For $d=\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)\geq1$, Assouad's bound gives $\log_2\mathrm{VC}^{*}(\mathcal H)\leq d+1\leq2d$. The zero case has dual VC dimension zero.
name: VC Dimension / Dual VC Dimension (logarithmic)
